---
title: "All news"
description: "All news published in the R Journal."
page-layout: full
title-block-banner: true
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| warning: false

library(yaml)

# List all news directories
news_dirs <- list.dirs("news", recursive = FALSE, full.names = FALSE)

# Extract year and issue from news ID (e.g., RJ-2022-1-cran or RN-2001-1-cran -> 2022/2001, 1)
get_year <- function(x) {
  match <- regmatches(x, regexec("R[JN]-(\\d{4})", x))[[1]]
  if (length(match) > 1) as.numeric(match[2]) else NA
}

get_issue <- function(x) {
  match <- regmatches(x, regexec("R[JN]-\\d{4}-(\\d+)", x))[[1]]
  if (length(match) > 1) as.numeric(match[2]) else NA
}

# Sort by year (descending), then issue (descending)
years <- sapply(news_dirs, get_year)
issues <- sapply(news_dirs, get_issue)
order_idx <- order(-years, -issues, news_dirs)
news_dirs <- news_dirs[order_idx]

# Group by year
unique_years <- unique(sapply(news_dirs, get_year))
unique_years <- unique_years[!is.na(unique_years)]
unique_years <- sort(unique_years, decreasing = TRUE)

for (year in unique_years) {
  cat(sprintf("\n## %s\n\n", year))

  year_news <- news_dirs[sapply(news_dirs, get_year) == year]

  for (news_id in year_news) {
    # Try to read metadata from .Rmd file
    rmd_file <- file.path("news", news_id, paste0(news_id, ".Rmd"))

    title <- NULL
    authors <- NULL
    date <- NULL

    if (file.exists(rmd_file)) {
      lines <- readLines(rmd_file, warn = FALSE)
      yaml_end <- which(lines == "---")[2]
      if (!is.na(yaml_end) && yaml_end > 2) {
        tryCatch({
          meta <- yaml.load(paste(lines[2:(yaml_end-1)], collapse = "\n"))
          title <- meta$title
          date <- meta$date

          # Extract author names
          if (!is.null(meta$author)) {
            if (is.list(meta$author)) {
              author_names <- sapply(meta$author, function(a) {
                if (is.list(a)) a$name else a
              })
              authors <- paste(author_names, collapse = ", ")
            } else {
              authors <- paste(meta$author, collapse = ", ")
            }
          }
        }, error = function(e) NULL)
      }
    }

    # Fallback for title
    if (is.null(title)) {
      title <- gsub("^R[JN]-\\d{4}-\\d+-", "", news_id)
      title <- gsub("-", " ", title)
      title <- tools::toTitleCase(title)
    }

    # Build the entry
    index_path <- sprintf("news/%s/index.qmd", news_id)
    pdf_path <- sprintf("news/%s/%s.pdf", news_id, news_id)

    if (file.exists(index_path)) {
      cat(sprintf("[%s](news/%s/)", title, news_id))
    } else if (file.exists(pdf_path)) {
      cat(sprintf("[%s](%s)", title, pdf_path))
    } else {
      cat(sprintf("**%s**", title))
    }

    if (!is.null(date) && !is.na(date)) {
      cat(sprintf(" (%s)", date))
    }

    cat("<br>")

    if (!is.null(authors) && length(authors) == 1 && nchar(authors) > 0) {
      cat(sprintf("*%s*", authors))
    }

    cat("\n\n")
  }
}
```
